exposure: first trimester pregnancy associated plasma protein-A (PAPP-A) levels
free beta human chorionic gonadotropin (fb-hCG) levels
cohort: The study included 23,482 women with singleton pregnancies from Northern Finland who participated in first trimester combined screening and delivered between 2014 and 2018, categorized into groups with GDM (n=4697) and without GDM (n=18,492).
finding: Association with low PAPP-A and SGA is present regardless of GDM status, whereas low fb-hCG levels are linked to SGA only in non-GDM pregnancies.
birth_weight: SGA defined as birthweight >2 SD below and LGA defined as birthweight >2 SD above sex-specific and gestational age-specific reference mean.
gest_age: SGA defined as birthweight >2 SD below and LGA defined as birthweight >2 SD above sex-specific and gestational age-specific reference mean.
